transform: Parse the original finite re74 source cell as binary64 and return exactly [re74]; no scaling, fitting, selection or use of any other field.
masks: none; one observed finite re74 coordinate required

timing.baseline_role: Retrospective pre-intervention covariate per primary NSW subset documentation

unit_identity: Source row ordinal under the exact dataset snapshot namespace; no claim of a cross-dataset subject identifier. Row ordinal is lineage only and must not be a matching feature.
claim_limit: A transparent raw descriptor, not a trained encoder or evidence of representation utility. No matching or effect estimate is produced.
